title: Ramsey number R(12,12), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_12 and no blue K_12; it shows R(12,12) > n. The best known lower bound is R(12,12) >= 1641, so a colouring of K_1640 is known and one of K_1641 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(12,12) >= 1641: Tatarevic, arXiv:2608.06531 (his inequality from R(11,11) >= 1597; colouring in his repository); Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed 1640; read 5 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
provenance.revision: revision 18 (24 Apr 2026) and later sources named

score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(12,12) >= n + 1 (larger is better)
